name: @release-toolkit/app-server
description: GitHub App webhook server for release-toolkit (Cloudflare Worker)

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @release-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @release-toolkit/changelog-presets build && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @release-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @release-toolkit/changelog-presets build && wrangler deploy
